compile_stan_model: compile a Stan model from code using BaseStanInference with a given seed and compile arguments
run_mcmc_inference: run MCMC sampling inference on an xarray dataset using the MCMC class with NUTS algorithm
run_vi_inference: run variational inference on an xarray dataset using the VI class with meanfield algorithm
extract_vb_params: extract variational bayes parameters from pystan vb results into a chain-dimensioned OrderedDict format
review_BaseStanInference: review the BaseStanInference class and its compile method for Stan model compilation
